title: Shortcut Learning in Geospatial Foundation Model Embeddings for Cross-Disaster Damage Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.13766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geospatial foundation models can support disaster damage assessment, but high accuracy on familiar disasters may hide shortcut learning: prediction from event or scene characteristics rather than evidence that transfers to a new disaster. We study embeddings from TerraMind, Prithvi-EO-2.0, DOFA, and DINOv3 on the multi-disaster datasets xView2 and BRIGHT. Holding out an entire disaster, instead of randomly splitting image tiles, reduces mean balanced accuracy from 0.807 to 0.638 on xView2 and from 0.818 to 0.568 on BRIGHT. Four sets of tests examine what information supports prediction: event and acquisition context, before/after image inputs, building count, and correct image pairing. Pre-event images remain predictive, and a classifier given only the annotated number of buildings reaches balanced accuracy of 0.629 and 0.653. Combining before/after features performs best on average on xView2, but does not improve over pre-only feature

translated_title: 地理空间基础模型嵌入中的捷径学习：面向跨灾害的损毁评估
translated_abstract: 地理空间基础模型可以支持灾害损毁评估，但在熟悉灾害上的高准确率可能隐藏着捷径学习：即基于事件或场景特征进行预测，而非依据能够迁移到新灾害的证据。我们研究了 TerraMind、Prithvi-EO-2.0、DOFA 和 DINOv3 在多灾害数据集 xView2 和 BRIGHT 上的嵌入表示。与随机划分图像切片相比，留出整个灾害进行测试会使 xView2 上的平均平衡准确率从 0.807 降至 0.638，BRIGHT 上的从 0.818 降至 0.568。四组实验检验了何种信息支持预测：事件与采集背景信息、灾前/灾后图像输入、建筑物数量以及正确的图像配对。结果表明灾前图像本身仍具有预测能力，而仅使用标注建筑物数量的分类器即可达到 0.629 和 0.653 的平衡准确率。在 xView2 上，结合灾前/灾后特征平均表现最佳，但并未超过仅使用灾前特征的表现。
tldr: 该研究揭示了地理空间基础模型在灾害损毁评估中存在捷径学习问题——留出整个灾害事件测试时性能大幅下降，且仅凭建筑物数量或灾前图像就能取得较高准确率，说明模型可能依赖事件/场景特征而非真正可迁移的损毁证据。
en_tdlr: This study reveals shortcut learning in geospatial foundation model embeddings for disaster damage assessment—holding out entire disasters sharply reduces accuracy, and classifiers achieve high performance using only building counts or pre-event images, indicating reliance on event/scene context rather than transferable damage evidence.
